meta_title: Bristol Painters & Decorators | Interior & Exterior Painting
meta_description: Bristol Painters and Decorators Ltd offers expert interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering across Bristol. Free quotes, professional finish guaranteed.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to stunning rooms. We transform Bristol homes with precision painting and expert decorating work.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Bristol
services_subhead: Whether you need an accent wall refreshed or a whole-house renovation, we deliver flawless finishes tailored to your home.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Professional interior painting for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and bathrooms. We prepare surfaces properly, use premium paints, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior work including fascias, soffits, doors, and full house repaints. We use trade-grade paints built to withstand Bristol's climate.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging and removal. We work with all paper types and create feature walls that transform a room's character instantly.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim
services.desc: Skirting boards, architraves, doors, and window frames refinished to a crisp, professional standard. Hand-finished for a superior look.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Shop fronts, offices, and commercial spaces decorated quickly and professionally. Minimal disruption to your business operations guaranteed.

services.title: Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: Full surface preparation including filling, sanding, and repairing cracks and damage. This foundation work ensures paint lasts years longer.

about_pullquote: We get the prep right because poor surfaces ruin even the best paint.
about_para_1: Bristol Painters and Decorators Ltd was founded 15 years ago by local craftsmen tired of seeing rushed, poor-quality work across Bristol's homes. Since then, we've built a reputation for meticulous preparation, premium finishes, and treating every property as if it were our own. Our team is fully trained and takes pride in every brushstroke.
about_para_2: We don't cut corners on surface prep or materials — that's why our paint finishes last. Our customers return because they know we'll arrive on time, respect their home, and deliver exactly what we promised. We're Bristol-based and deeply invested in the community we serve.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our whole ground floor redecorated — living room, hallway, kitchen. The lads were incredibly tidy, worked efficiently, and the finish is beautiful. Really pleased. Will have them back for upstairs next year.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Called them on a Friday to ask about our exterior doors and fascia. Got a quote the next morning, work completed by the following Thursday. Professional outfit. No mess, fair price, looks smart.
reviews.author: Catherine M.

reviews.text: Needed our bedroom wallpapered as a surprise for my mum. These guys fitted it in at short notice, hung the paper perfectly, and even repaired the wall where it needed it. Honest, reliable, and reasonably priced.
reviews.author: James P.
